description: This file defines the 'GSIMContainer' class, a data container used within the Fineract project to encapsulate information related to savings account groups, including IDs, account details, child accounts, balance, and status.

classes.name: GSIMContainer
classes.description: A data holder class that stores identifiers, account information, child account summaries, balance, and savings status for a savings account grouping.

methods.name: GSIMContainer (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of GSIMContainer with specified IDs, account number, child accounts, balance, and status.

methods.name: getChildGSIMAccounts
methods.description: Returns the list of child savings account summaries.
